item.title: Superfest Manila Returns To City Of Dreams This February 7-8
item.description: The engines are roaring once again as 2026 Superfest Manila, presented by Bumper to Bumper Car Show, returns for its third year at City of Dreams Manila on February 7 and 8. This annual showcase merges motoring passion, lifestyle entertainment, and global car culture with over 80 standout vehicles, interactive activities and a chance to win the raffle draw grand prize for an all-expense paid trip to Japan by Autotour Japan. Participation in the raffle is exclusive for Melco Club members.Read Mor

item.title: Review: 2026 Hyundai Elantra 1.6 HEV Premium 6DCT
item.description: Let’s admit one thing for a second: before the seventh-generation Elantra reached Philippine shores, the nameplate wasn’t synonymous with cutting-edge tech. While they’ve managed to re-write the design book on occasion, they often hide something more modest under the hood. This time, Hyundai has decided to go all out and pair those head-turning looks with a powertrain to match. The result? A great value hybrid compact sedan that’s also, gasp, fun to drive.Read More »

item.title: Suzuki Philippines Strengthens Environmental Stewardship With Pawikan Release In Bataan
item.description: Suzuki Philippines reaffirmed its commitment to environmental conservation through a meaningful Pawikan (sea turtle) release activity held at the Pawikan Conservation Center in Morong, Bataan. The activity brought together Suzuki Philippines leaders and team members in support of marine wildlife protection and sustainability.Read More »
